title: Invariant random Schreier decorations of simple regular unimodular random rooted graphs of even degree at least four
author: László Márton Tóth
work: Invariant Schreier decorations of unimodular random networks
source_version: Annales Henri Lebesgue 4 (2021), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/ahl.114
difficulty_reason: The author constructs root-independent random balanced orientations, derives measurable nearly optimal bipartite edge colorings despite finite-component obstructions, and uses weak compactness with partial measure-preserving root moves to obtain a fully invariant decoration. This measurable graphing construction exceeds ordinary qualifying examinations.
